description: Weekly mean temperature from updated hourly weather

description: Weekly mean relative humidity from updated hourly weather
hypothesis: High humidity supports infection and leaf wetness persistence
known_limitations: Province-level weather may miss local humidity pockets

description: Weekly precipitation total
hypothesis: Rainfall and wetness can support infection but may be noisy
known_limitations: Rainfall alone is not a stable national predictor

description: Weekly proxy count of wet/high-humidity hours

description: Share of weekly hours classified as leaf-wet proxy

description: Explainable weather-risk score from temperature humidity rainfall and wetness

known_limitations: Longer memory not consistently better

description: Three-week accumulated weather risk
